evals.prompt: Plan from specs missing schemas and flows.
evals.expected_output: Blocks with spec gaps; no executable tickets.

evals.prompt: Create parallel tickets from approved specs.
evals.expected_output: Creates waves, indexes, scoped AFK tickets, acceptance, and verification.

evals.prompt: Review a ticket asking agents to decide schema, retry, and tests.
evals.expected_output: Rejects it as not implementation-ready and returns gaps to specs.

evals.prompt: Plan a TypeScript interface foundation followed by parallel backend and frontend tickets.
evals.expected_output: Creates a contract-first wave with frozen interfaces, isolated write scopes, parallel backend/frontend tickets, and one end-to-end wave outcome.

evals.prompt: Review a plan with placeholder backend responses and no partial/done tracking.
evals.expected_output: Rejects placeholder implementations and requires pause/resume status tracking for planned, in-progress, partial, blocked, done, and skipped work.

evals.prompt: Review an implementation plan with no self-audit.
evals.expected_output: Rejects readiness until Self-Audit records weakest assumptions, evidence, fake-work risk, parallel-boundary risk, and blockers or none.
